source_message:
feat(utils): G-13 Compliance Snapshot Bundle — ZIP export for auditors, 28 tests

- compliance_snapshot.py: ComplianceSnapshot dataclass, collect_snapshot(),
  export_snapshot_zip(), to_markdown() for MLRO; collects policy checksums
  (SHA-256), invariants count, test results, passports count, rego rules,
  GAP summary, thresholds, git SHA; ZIP contains snapshot.json + snapshot.md
  + 5 artefact files (compliance_config.yaml, INVARIANTS.md, GAP-REGISTER.md,
  change-classes.yaml, trust-zones.yaml)
- CLI: python -m compliance.utils.compliance_snapshot --output /tmp/audit.zip
- 28 tests T-01..T-28 (collection, checksums, ZIP content, idempotency,
  graceful missing files, to_markdown sections)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
